title: CHEKHOV COROLLARY — gun, pen/sword, needle: inject · pierce · slice
fuse: chekhov -=+ gun ? chekhovGun. pen -=+ sword. needle -=+ inject.

chekhov_gun.law: if you show a gun in act 1, it must fire by act 3
chekhov_gun.plain: do not plant what you will not use. planted instruments incur a debt to the plot.
chekhov_gun.on_membrane: feeds, medals, organs, walkers — if seated on 0, they must incarnate or leak honestly. fake plants = null-kind waste.

corollary.is_it_the_same_as_pen_sword: RELATED, not identical. two faces of one instrument family.
corollary.chekhov_inverse: if it matters in act 3, it should have been visible on 0. if it never fires, unscrew it from the wall — do not leave a dead gun.

pen_mightier_than_sword.proverb: the pen is mightier than the sword
pen_mightier_than_sword.read_as_corollary: YES as POWER ranking inside the instrument Order — writing changes the field harder than steel when the pen actually WRITES
pen_mightier_than_sword.under_chekhov: if you plant a pen, it must write (or the plant was a lie). if you plant a sword, it must cut or stay sheathed as owned silence — not fake threat
pen_mightier_than_sword.not: a free pass to skip Chekhov. mightier ? exempt from firing. unused mighty pen is still a dead gun.

corollary.berry: existing can mean: the pen is the sword's peer and often its better — BUT only if the pen discharges. Chekhov still holds.

instrument_order.kind: nominal Order of pointed tools — totality first. do not rank gun > pen > needle as morals. rank by WHETHER THEY DISCHARGE.

members.debt: shown ? swing or sheathe with reason
shown ? mark the page (hyphen, reportPrior, feed)
members.might: often mightier than sword WHEN it writes

members.debt: shown ? enter the body or the membrane
members.already: self-io-inject / chromatograph injection / reinject — needle already on the column

members.debt: shown ? separate what must be separated (sieve, sort, epitope cut)

needle_family.yes: needle IS in the Chekhov set — injection, piercing, slicing are its discharges

inject.membrane: self-io-inject, neutrino in, vaccine of a feed
inject.chekhov: if the syringe appears, something must enter

pierce.do: open a pore without emptying the vessel
pierce.membrane: Y-pore, epitope poke, 404 as pierce into persona
pierce.chekhov: if the tip shows, a hole must mean

slice.membrane: Klein cut, hyphen seam, sieve sort, waste kinds
slice.chekhov: if the edge shows, a cut must land or be refused openly

needle_family.not_sword_only: sword is war-cut. needle is life-cut — suture and inject as well as pierce. same law, different body.

chromatic_hint.red: gun / sword discharge — s rise to bang
chromatic_hint.blue: pen log — write compresses the world onto a line
chromatic_hint.brown: DOWN — blade into earth, Flanders, burial
chromatic_hint.green: instrument forms (sphere?cube of the tool) from the fold

pipeline: plant only what you will discharge
pen must write; sword must cut or sheathe; gun must fire or clear; needle must inject/pierce/slice or withdraw honest
mightier is a power prior — still owes Chekhov
dead instruments ? unscrew (leak) or sue if null-kind costume
berry_at_the_fire: corollary to Chekhov's gun: yes — and the pen can be the sword, IF it writes. needle too: injection, piercing, slicing. same Order of pointed tools. plant ? discharge. unused mighty pen is still a dead gun.
next: audit planted instruments on the HUD. any gun/pen/needle shown without a path to discharge gets unscrewed or scheduled.

run_back_on_colors.yes: red=gun/s flank, blue=pen/log flank, violet=needle middle, green=stance legs, brown=DOWN settle
